feedback.title: Try again
feedback.body: An image removes selectable text and clear document structure, and its single click target obscures the action's meaning.

feedback.title: Correct

feedback.body: Visual styling changes appearance but does not give browsers, keyboards, or assistive tools the missing roles.

en.question: An article's main heading is only enlarged generic text, and View source is a clickable generic container. How should this be fixed?

options: 把标题和原文入口做进一张图片，再给整张图绑定点击
用合适的 HTML 标题和链接元素表达结构与跳转
保留现有容器，只继续加大字号并换成更醒目的颜色

feedback.title: 这个答案不太对
feedback.body: 图片会丢失可选择文字和清楚的内容结构，入口范围与含义也难以被正确识别。

feedback.title: 回答正确
feedback.body: HTML 元素会把标题层级和链接角色交给浏览器识别，页面外观仍可继续由 CSS 控制。

feedback.title: 这个答案不太对
feedback.body: 视觉样式能改变外观，却不会让浏览器、键盘和辅助技术识别标题结构或链接角色。
